directive_basis: R407-F: finalize P11's experiment so that it is ready to execute immediately after P04; no elaborate new simulation; the decisive test is P11 vs ASD/control with pre-registered settling time, steady-state flow error, MDD, kill condition
supersedes_or_extends: LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P11/EXPERIMENT_PREREGISTRATION.json (R406 — numeric rules carried forward UNCHANGED; this contract adds the machine-executable decision layer and the execution-order gate)
machine_decision_module: discovery_fabric/engine/reality_ingestion.py::decide_p11 (pure function; thresholds frozen to the pre-registration values)

execution_order_gate.directive: P11 executes IMMEDIATELY AFTER P04's contract resolves (KEEP, MODIFY with re-registration, or KILL) — parallel at protocol level only, never at bench-resource level
execution_order_gate.reason: the CEO priority order (P04 first, P11 second); both contracts share the mock-loop apparatus class, so the P04 outcome informs the bench schedule

hypothesis: The annular-gap hydraulic damper settles to within 10% of steady-state flow at least 20% faster than a REAL commercial anti-siphon device at all four postural pressures, AND its steady-state flow accuracy (mean absolute deviation from the linear-in-pressure target) is not statistically worse than the ASD at any tested pressure.
null_hypothesis: the damper is not >= 20% faster than the ASD at some pressure (kill condition A) or its target-flow accuracy is worse than the ASD (kill condition B)

baseline.control_1_ASD: a REAL commercial anti-siphon device — the incumbent baseline the differentiators are claimed against (not a modeled ASD)
baseline.blinding: blinded analysis: the analysis script receives arm labels as anonymized codes A/B/C, unsealed only after the primary-endpoint verdicts are computed and committed

treatment.arm: the hydraulic damper element (annular-gap architecture, 0.18 mm gap class) inline in the mock CSF loop
treatment.manufacturing_tolerance: prototypes at 0.18 mm +/- 0.01 mm annular gap, implant-grade polymer; gap metrology record required before the run; out-of-tolerance prototypes are excluded and REPORTED (never silently dropped)

apparatus.apparatus_id: P11-BENCH-001 (assigned at procurement; does not yet exist — same funding reality as P04)
apparatus.description: mock CSF loop: programmable pressure-head reservoir, flow sensor (0.01 mL/min resolution class), postural-step actuation, continuous acquisition >= 10 Hz, temperature-controlled fluid
apparatus.matrix: 3 arms x 4 postural pressures (10/20/30/40 mmHg) x 10 runs per arm-pressure x 2 step profiles (physiological 1-3 s transition AND fast-step stress case)

sample_count.rule: 10 runs per arm per pressure (the recorded R339 protocol); damper prototypes per the manufacturing tolerance gate

endpoint_1_settling_time.definition: time from postural pressure step to flow settling within 10% of steady state (per run)
endpoint_1_settling_time.headline_claim_under_test: damper settles 0.1 s FASTER than ASD (MODELLED: tau = I_h/c_h; 0.4 s vs 0.5 s class)
endpoint_1_settling_time.MDD_provenance: LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P11/INSTRUMENT_MDD_CALCULATION.json (COMPUTATIONAL_RESULT: MDD 0.0253 s at p<0.05, n=10/arm — the claimed 0.1 s difference is 3.95x the MDD, DETECTABLE)
endpoint_1_settling_time.kill_condition_A: the response-speed differentiator is NOT established — KILL unless endpoint 2 is decisively positive — if the damper's mean settling time is not >= 20% faster than the ASD arm at ALL four postural pressures
endpoint_1_settling_time.kill_A_threshold_class: MODEL_DERIVED (engineering-judgment proposal, R405-recorded; registered at R406 — NEVER presented as a clinical-materiality derivation)
endpoint_1_settling_time.statistics: paired comparison per pressure: mean settling time damper vs ASD, one-sided test, alpha 0.05, n=10 pairs

endpoint_2_steady_state_flow_error.definition: flow-trace proportionality error: mean absolute deviation of instantaneous flow from the linear-in-pressure target trajectory across the step (per run); and target-flow accuracy at steady state
endpoint_2_steady_state_flow_error.headline_claim_under_test: the damper modulates flow proportionally/continuously where the ASD acts stepwise
endpoint_2_steady_state_flow_error.kill_condition_B: the safety case is negative — KILL — if the damper's target-flow accuracy (mean absolute deviation from target flow at steady state) is statistically worse than the ASD arm at ANY tested pressure
endpoint_2_steady_state_flow_error.statistics: paired one-sided test per pressure, alpha 0.05 (Wilcoxon signed-rank on paired per-pressure means; n=10 pairs)

ordered_rules: R0 EXECUTION_INVALID: no settling data or malformed pairs
R1 KILLED-A+B: kill condition A (speed) AND kill condition B (accuracy) both triggered
R2 KILLED-A: not >= 20% faster at all pressures and endpoint 2 not decisively positive
R3 KILLED-B: flow accuracy worse than ASD at any pressure
R4 SUPPORTED: both kill conditions avoided AND endpoint 1 decisively positive (>= 20% faster at ALL pressures) AND endpoint 2 not worse
R5 MIXED: one differentiator positive, the other null — recorded exactly so; no partial promotion (MIXED maps to the MODIFY class: a registered change + re-run)
decision_rule.no_human_reinterpretation: the verdict is computed by the pure function from the paired means; every branch is exercised by tests

model_update_hook.prediction_before_registered: settling time 0.4 s (damper) / 0.5 s (ASD class) per the first-order model tau = I_h/c_h — the bench measurement updates this model through the R407-C adjudication machinery (error_before / error_after / held_out_error; LEARNING_FAILED is a valid outcome)

cost_and_time.recorded: $15K / 8 weeks (R339-recorded for this exact protocol class)
cost_and_time.wider_range_context: $15-38K (REPORTED audit itemization: loop $3-8K; prototypes $5-15K; commercial ASD controls $2-5K; personnel $5-10K)

timeline.gating_item: executes immediately after the P04 contract resolves; same sponsor reality (REAL_BUYER = 0)

registration_event.no_post_hoc_rule: any post-collection change to a registered threshold voids the run (Art. XXVII)

honest_limits: mock loop fluid is water/CSF-mimic (NIST 310.15 K viscosity class; CSF residual disclosed)
excludes biological fouling and in-vivo compliance
clinical materiality of the settling difference is NOT established by this bench (engineering materiality only)
commercial ASD device tolerances may differ from the modeled ASD profile (why a REAL ASD is the comparator)
at 0.1 mL/min steady flow the 10% settling band equals the 0.01 mL/min flowmeter resolution — runs below 0.2 mL/min are flagged resolution-limited (never silently included or excluded)
constitutional_basis: Art. LII, Art. XXVII, Art. XLVII (REAL ASD comparator, identical instrument, baseline unchanged across arms)
